summary: Plan 06 P7 is delivered with a CP08-prep0 base-test bridge, a CP08-prep canonical-V3 expand checkpoint and a CP08 contract checkpoint: prep0 makes base-owned manifest and tools tests valid across the transition; prep switches IFX callers and ownership to canonical V3, passes an external generation root and turns the workflow-facing legacy runner into a thin wrapper while internal copies still exist; CP08 parameterizes the Stage Gate, removes tracked generated source and duplicate implementations, and retains only declared public wrappers.
rationale: The trusted-base candidate verifier overlays every base-owned test from the base into the candidate. The old manifest suite requires the legacy runner to remain byte-identical and uses an existing legacy setup script as its untrusted-workflow negative control; the old tools suite compares generated bytes with a tracked snapshot whose checkout line endings vary by platform. CP08-prep0 therefore changes only those tests first. CP08-prep can then move callers and ownership to canonical V3, turn the workflow-facing legacy runner into a thin forwarder, and pass the trusted runner's generation root outside both head and base. CP08 finally maps ProjectId deterministically to a legal dotnet identifier, rejects collisions, generates Self/Post/Diff under <generation-root>/<package>/gates/stage, removes tracked generated source and deletes internal scripts, hooks, tests and templates through exact authorization. Required-check names and ruleset remain unchanged. This refines D1, D3, D6, D9 and D14.
